headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.4264). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 5 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.51 (95% CI: 0.4–0.64), suggesting that lutein is associated with a lower risk of uterine cancer. These findings were supported by moderate between-study heterogeneity (I² = 28.88%), suggesting some variability in the results across studies.
